description: For any supplied effective compilers of \(\psi\), the specified maps \(\pi=h_{G,F}\) and \(\kappa=k_{G,F}\) are total computable and satisfy \(\kappa(\pi(e))=e\), \(\pi(\kappa(n))=n\), and \(\psi_{\pi(e)}(x)\simeq\varphi_e(x)\) for every \(e,n,x\in\mathbb N\). Thus the actual matching maps give a computable permutation with a computable inverse, preserving entire partial functions.
